description: The pie chart shows the distribution of languages represented in the “OpenAssistant Conversations — Democratizing Large Language Model Alignment” paper dataset, with 10 slices in total. The largest slice is English (dark blue), occupying roughly just under half of the circle (no percentage label visible on the slice), followed by Spanish (medium blue) labeled 31.4%. Smaller slices include Other (very light blue) at 5.8% and Russian (blue) at 5.7%, then German (lighter blue) at 3.6%, French (light blue) at 2.9%, Chinese (very light blue) at 2.5%, Thai (pale blue) at 1.9%, Portuguese (Brazil) (pale blue) at 1.7%, and Catalan (pale blue) at 1.6%. Percentage labels appear inside most slices, and category names are placed around the pie; there is no separate legend and no slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized, with slices visually arranged from the largest (English/Spanish) to progressively smaller segments.
